tei:titleStmt.tei:title: thog ma babs kyi bde gshegs snying po'i don/ /ma 'khrul ma nor mngon sum 'doms mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bde gshegs chos kyi rje/ /bstan pa'i nya
thog ma babs kyi bde gshegs snying po'i don/ /ma 'khrul ma nor mngon sum 'doms mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bde gshegs chos kyi rje/ /bstan pa'i nya

tei:div.tei:p: thog ma babs kyi bde gshegs snying po'i don// ma 'khrul ma nor mngon sum 'doms mdzad pa'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma bde gshegs chos kyi rje// bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// ston pa'i zhal mthong dge bsnyen li tsa

gzhon nu 'jig rten thams cad kyi mthong na dga' ba/ bi// bde gshegs mdzod rnga bo che mdo nas lung bstan pa/ 'dzin dge slong blo 'chang dang*// lang kar gshegs pa/ sprin chen/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs mdo rgyud kun/ lung gis bsngags pa'i slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs// ston pa'i lung zin gsum la gsol ba 'debs// dbu ma'i dgongs pa gsal byed rmad byung slob dpon bzhi'i ya gyal/ zla ba grags// rig pa'i dbang phyug rgyan drug gi nang tshan tshad ma'i slob dpon/ dharmā kirti dang*// yum don mngon gyur slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi rang mkhas kyi slob ma bzhi'i nang tshan/ blo gros brtan pa'i zhabs// 'phags yul mkhas pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs// 'od gsal ston pa bka' babs kyi rig 'dzin brgyad las 'jam dpal sku'i rig 'dzin/ mañdzu mi tra dang*// grub pa'i dbang phyug nor bu yang dag thugs kyi slob dpon ste hūm̐ ka ra/ go leb dang*// 'od lus grub pa paṇa chen bdud rtsi yon tan gyi bka' babs/ man ngag snying thig gi shing rta chen po/ bī ma la// rnal 'byor dbang po gsum la gsol ba 'debs// skad gnyis smra ba ska cog zhang gsum gyi nang tshan/ nā ga dhā dza dang*// ting 'dzin drod brnyes 'od lus grub pa nyang*/ ting 'jin bzang po dang*// bod kyi bka' babs kyi nang tshan/ /yang dag grub pa nam mkha'i snying po'i zhabs// bod yul lo tsā gsum la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi skye ba rgyal po nyi ma rnam par gnon pa/ lo paṇa thang yig dang dbyangs can ma'i lo rgyus las gsungs/ rgyal po rnam par gnon// 'dzam gling rgyal po thugs sras rje 'bangs grogs gsum nang rje khri srong lde'u btsan nam/ lha yi me tog dang*// bstan pa'i gsos byed rgyal po sa skyong sde dge chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring*/ bstan pa'i mtshan// chos kyi rgyal po gsum la gsol ba 'debs// chos kyi rgyal po

'od gsal snying thig gi bstan pa'i bdag po kun mkhyen/ klong chen rab 'byams dang*// rig pa smra ba sa skya mkhas pa rnam drug tu grags pa'i ya gyal kun mkhyen go ram pa chen po/ bsod nams seng ge dang*// 'dul ba'i gzhi 'dzin kaḥthog 'bum pa rnam gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan dbu 'od/ ye shes 'bum pa'i zhabs// bod yul mkhas pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs// zab gter mnga' bdag mchog gi gter ston gnyis kyi snga ma nyang*/ nyi ma 'od zer dang*// gu rus byin brlabs mkha' 'gro snying thig gi bstan pa'i bdag po/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// 'brel tshad don ldan gling pa brgyad kyi nang tshan/ karma gling pa'i zhabs// gter ston rig 'dzin gsum la gsol ba 'debs// tshul khrims dri med rin chen blo gros dang*// ting 'dzin g.yo med bi ma'i ye shes kyi skus byin gyis brlabs pa lce btsun chen po/ seng ge dbang phyug dang*// shes rab spyan dag spyan ras gzigs bshes gnyen gyi tshul bzung ba mkhas grub/ karma chags med zhabs// 'di yan gyi mchan rnams khungs ldan las rang gar bris pa med pas 'chos par mi bya'o/ bya bral rnal 'byor gsum la gsol ba 'debs// nam snying gi sku/ chos rgyal gyi gsung*/ bī ma'i thugs/ lha lcam gyi yon tan/ cog ro'i phrin las kyi sprul pa'i cha shas yin snyam/ zhes pa'i phyag bris 'dug chos nyid dgongs pa bar mtshams (15)med par rtogs// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla mas byin brlabs pas// 'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin// rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba 'debs so rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs// byin brgyud dgongs pa'i drod chen snying la stsol// byin rlabs thugs rjes dbang bzhi'i chu bo yis// nyon mongs sgrib bzhi dbyings su dag par mdzod// gnas skabs rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i lam mchog nas// dbang gis rgyud smin dam tshig rnam par dag

/bskyed rdzogs don la rang byan tshud pa dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char bzhin phobs// mthar thug rang rig don gyi bla ma nyid// rig stong zung 'jug kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin// lhun grub sku bzhi'i ngo bor ro gcig shog / ces lung stong gi smyon pa/ gnas stong gi sprang po/ thang stong gi rgyal po/ rig 'dzin gyis gces phrug mkha' 'gro ma'i snying sdug chos skyong gi bla rdo/ 'khor 'das kyi dwangs ma/ dam chos kyi 'byung gnas/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab/ na chung gi mdza' bo/ grogs med kyi gcig pu/ gang byung gis chog pa/ gang snang la rol pa/ yin min las 'das pa/ rdzogs chen gyi rnal 'byor/ bya bral gyi rgyal po/ gzhon nu srid pa'i dwangs rtse/ zhes 'bod pa des bskul ba po'i (sangs rgyas skyabs/)ngag ma ldog tsam du nyin de nyid la shar mar bris pa'o/ / ༈ slar yang skye rabs bsdus pa ni// phyi ltar slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*// nang ltar rig 'dzin chen po hūm̐ kāḥr// gsang ba paṇa chen bī ma mi tra'i zhabs// yang gsang chos kyi rgyal po klong chen pa// rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// shes rab chen pos chos kyi de nyid gzigs// snying rje chen pos 'gro rnams rjes su 'dzin// dpal ldan bla mas rjes bzung mkhyen brtse'i gter// ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'di dang phyi ma bar do thams cad du// 'bral med brtse bas rjes bzung smin grol gyi// gsang chen bdud rtsi thob nas 'gro kun gyi// rtag tu phan bde 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa 'di ni gter chen rin po che'i zhal snga nas 'jam dpal dgyes pa zil gnon ngag gi dbang po'am rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal du 'bod pa'i snyoms las pa des gang shar bris pa'o// ༈ 'od gsal rin chen snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// las 'brel rig rtsal rdzogs par dbang thob cing*// kun bzang pad+ma dbang gi rig pa 'dzin// theg mchog bstan pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs//

zhabs brtan gsol zhes kha bsgyur bas chog /zhes pa'ang rgyal ba'i sras po kun tu bzang pos de la snying thig ma bu'i dbang gi gtad rgya thob dus ming mnga' gsol ba de nyid kha bsgyur ba dad pa'i bu slob rnams kyi mos ngor chos smra ba pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa'o// ༈ rgyal kun thugs kyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems// sras bcas rgyal ba ma lus khyab bdag mchog /bka' drin mtshungs med dpal mgon bla ma rje// ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// ces smras so/ rgyal kun thugs kyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems// ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam rol bī ma la// dbyer med chos kyi rgyal po klong chen pa// pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// rang byung rig pa'i ye shes mngon sum rtogs// ma bcos chos nyid gnyug ma'i rgyun sgom pa'i// mthar thug rang rig don gyi bla ma mchog /kun bzang chos sku'i dgongs klong ro gcig shog / ces pa'ang a bsod lha mo'i ngor pad+ma las 'brel gyis so/ ༈ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems// lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan paṇa chen bī ma la// ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam rol ngag gi dbang*// rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// zhes bla ma la gsol ba dung nger btab pas bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i ngang la/ rig pa rjen la bud pa gnyug ma rang babs kyi dran pa mi g.yo gsum ldan gyis mnyam par bzhag nas/ rtsal gyi rnam rtog thams cad 'phro ba mi dgag gnas pa mi bsgrub/ 'phro gnas rang grol chen por bskyang ngo*// bla ma dge 'dun bzang po'i ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis so/ / ༈ 'od gsal rin chen snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// las 'brel rig rtsal rdzogs par dbang thob cing*// kun bzang pad+ma dbang gi rig pa 'dzin// theg mchog bstan pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs// mgon po khyed kyi ye shes thugs rje'i mthus// zang thal gzhi rdzogs don gyi ye shes mchog

/tshe 'di nyid la mngon sum rtogs nas kyang*// gdod ma'i grub mtha' snyog par byin gyis rlobs// sras chen gyis bskul ngor mkhan ming pas so/ / ༈ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems// lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan paṇa chen bī ma la// dbyer med rtsa ba'i blal mar gsol ba 'debs// dal 'byor snying po lon par byin gyis rlobs// mi rtag 'chi ba dran pas rgyud bskul nas// las 'bras gnas la nges par yid ches te// 'khor ba'i chos la nges 'byung shugs drag pos// skyabs gsum tshad mar bzung nas byang chub sems// mi ldog brtan pos phyin drug bslab pa yis// rdzogs smin sbyangs pa rgya mtsho mthar phyin nas// 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa'i lam// smin grol zab mos rang rgyud legs smin te// mthar thug sku dang ye shes rgya mtsho khams// mngon gyur gdod ma'i sa la phyin par shog / ces pa'ang slob bu sangs rgyas ngor mkhan ming pas bris pa yongs la dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ dpal mgon bla ma kun bzang chos kyi sku// rdo rje sems dpa' rigs kun 'dus pa'i rje// klong chen rab 'byams gang shar rang grol rtsal// pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// mngon sum rang rig rtogs pa tshad la phebs// sku dang zhing khams gdod ma'i rgyal khab tu// mthar thug rang rig don gyi bla ma dang*// dbyer med sa mchog dam pa mngon gyur nas// mkha' khyab zhing gi gdul bya ma lus pa// thabs kyi theg pa mchog gi lam ston zhing*// 'khor ba dong sprug phrin las snang ba'i sgo /'bad med lhun grub 'gro ba'i dpal du shog / ces pa'ang lha dbang ngor 7pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis so/ / ༈ brgyud gsum man ngag gsang ba'i gter mdzod 'chang*// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rtsa gsum kun bdag nyid// bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// don brgyud dgongs pa'i drod chen snying la stsol// sems nyid rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gshis// gnyug ma'i shes pa zang thal rjen pa'i klong*// chos nyid rang bab lhun grub rgya yan ngang*// dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin par byin gyis rlobs//

rag chab bla ma bkra shis kyis bskul ngor btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos so/ / ༈ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug paṇa chen bī ma la// ye shes sgyu ma'i gar mkhan bla ma rje// dbang bzhi'i rgyal thabs mchog sbyin rin po che// drin chen bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gsang chen dbang bzhis sgo gsum sgrib sbyang nas// bskyed rim lam gyis snang srid lha skur dag /rdzogs rim gsang ba chen pos rgyud sbyangs te// zung 'jug kun bzang go 'phang thob par shog / ces pa'ang rig 'dzin bla ma dam pa'i sku'i rigs su gyur pa rigs ldan bsam gtan sgron ma'i bzhed skong du mkhan ming pas bris pa'o/ / ༈ rgyal kun thugs mchog dpal ldan rdo rje sems// 'pho chen dwangs ma'i sku brnyes bī ma la// chos zad dgongs pa mngon gyur klong chen pa// dbyer med bla ma rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// don brgyud dgongs pa'i drod chen snying la stsol// tshe 'dir rtse gcig sgrub la gzhol ba dang*/ khyed thugs dbyer med ro gcig byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes sgrub brtson bsod nams dbang drag ming sring gis bskul ngor btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos bris pa'o/ / ༈ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems// ye shes sgyu ma paṇa chen bī ma la// dbyer med kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po la// gsol ba 'debs so chos sku'i don rtogs shog /lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa las 'brel rtsal// thugs rje sgyu ma'i rnam rol ngag gi dbang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid rig stong rjen pa rtogs par shog /rang babs cog bzhag chen po'i dgongs pa yis// chos nyid dgongs pa drod tshad rnyed pa dang*// skye 'chi bar dor grol ba'i gdengs thob nas// kun bzang chos sku'i gtan srid zin par shog / ces pa'ang rtse drung ngag dbang dpal ldan ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa'o//

༈ dpal mgon bla ma kun bzang chos kyi sku// rdo rje sems dpa' rigs kun 'dus pa'i rje// klong chen rab 'byams gang shar rang sar grol// pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// mngon sum rang rig rtogs pa tshad la phebs// sku dang zhing khams gdod ma'i rgyal khab tu// mthar thug rang rig don gyi bla ma dang*// dbyer med sa mchog dam pa mngon gyur nas// mkha' khyab zhing gi gdul bya ma lus pa// thabs kyi theg pa mchog gi lam ston zhing*// 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las snang ba'i sgo /'bad med lhun grub 'gro ba'i dpal du shog /ces pa'ang bla ma dam pa tshul rnam mos ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis so// ༈ 'od gsal rin chen snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// las 'brel rig rtsal rjogs pa'i dbang thob pa'i// kun bzang pad+ma dbang gi rig pa 'dzin// pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// khams gsum dbang sdud dbang chen rta mchog dpal// srid gsum dbang byed ku ru kul+le ma// chags pas dbang sdud lha chen yab yum rnams// mgon po khyod las gzhan du ma mchis pas// rtse gcig gdung bas nam yang khyod brten na// rnal 'byor nang gi rtsa rlung thig le'i khams// don dam dbu ma chen por dbang bsgyur nas// snang sems las rung 'khor ba'i mdud pa grol// phyi ru gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa dbyings su dag /tshe dang bsod nams klung rta gong 'phel nas// snang sems dbang 'dus mi mthun phyogs zhi nas// chos mthun bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// ces pa'ang dad ldan tshe grags ngor 7pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o// ༈ kun bzang chos sku'i ston pa klong chen pa// lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku las 'brel rtsal// dbyer med ngag gi dbang por gsol ba 'debs// don brgyud dgongs pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// kun bzang bla ma khyed kyis rjes bzung nas// rdzogs smin sbyangs pa rgya mtsho mthar phyin nas// dpal ldan sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog

/ ces pa'ang rig 'dzin ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis so/ / ༈ kun tu bzang mo rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo wā rā hī// gsang chen bka' yi sdud po mtsho rgyal ma// bde chen rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces so// ༈ rgyal ba'i ye shes las byung ba'i// 'chi med 'phags ma rnam par rgyal// dbyer med dz+nyā na sā' ga rar// gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsol// bu ska li nyi ma'i ngor mkhan ming pas so// ༈ bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// dpal mgon bla ma khyed kyis rjes bzung nas// rnam dag tshul khrims gtsang mas rgyud bsdam zhing*// zhi lhag gnyis kyi ting 'dzin la goms shing*// bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab rgya chen pos// theg chen lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin shog /rnam dag dbang gi chu bos smin byas nas// bskyed pa'i rim pas snang srid lha skur dag /rdzogs pa'i rim pas rlung sems dbu mar dag /bskyed rdzogs gnyis la rang byan chud par shog khyad par rdzogs pa chen po'i lam mchog gi /smin byed dbang gis sku bzhis ngo bor smin/ khregs chod thod rgal lam gyi rtsal rdzogs nas// snang bzhi mthar phyin sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob// gzhan don ris med mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi// phan bde ma lus 'grub pa'i phrin las kyis// mkha' khyab zhing gi 'gro ba 'dren par shog /

ces pa'ang go 'jo tshe dbang 'gyur med ngor pad+ma las 'brel gyis so// ༈ 'pho med 'ja' lus sku brnyes bī ma la// ye shes sgyu ma kun mkhyen klong chen pa// dbyer med rig 'dzin pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// ngag gi dbangapo'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag ni deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// kun mkhyen bla ma khyed kyi gdul bya ru// dal 'byor bco brgyad ldan pa'i lus thob nas// rnam dag tshul khrims bslab pas rgyud bsdam zhing*// ting 'dzin sgo 'phar 'bum phrag rang dbang bsgyur// bden gnyis mngon par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis// mdo rgyud man ngag zab mo'i don rtogs shing*// rnam dag lam gyi gzhi ma legs mthong nas// phyin drug gis bsdus mdo sngags spyod pa yis// rdzogs smin sbyangs pa rgya mtsho mthar phyin nas// mtha' yas mkha' mnyam 'dren par bdag 'gyur zhing*// mthar thug rang rig don gyi bla ma dang*// kun bzang chos sku'i dgongs pa ro gcig shog / ces tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam g.yu khog bla ma rdo rje'i bskul ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig ༈ sa mchog dkyil 'khor mngon gyur bī ma la// kun bzang chos sku'i ston pa klong chen pa// pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// 'di phyi bar do gsum la thugs rjes bzung*// bar do dang po'i 'od gsal shar ba'i tshe// ngo shes rtsal rdzogs brtan pa thob nas kyang*/ khyad chos drug ldan dbyings su byang chub nas// gzhonanu bum skur brtan pa thob par shog /rig rtsal longs sku'i snang cha shar ba'i tshe// ma pang bu 'jug lta bu'i gdeng thob cing*// 'od dang rig pa 'jug pa'i gnad mthong nas// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru sangs rgyas shog /rnam smin srid pa bar do shar ba'i dus// ma sgom sangs rgyas chos lnga'i lam brten nas// rnam grol dbugs chen 'byin pa'i zhing khams su// skye ba gcig gis sangs rgyas thob par shog

/ ces pa'ang tshul khrims dpal mo'i ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge'o// ༈ mtshungs med bla ma bskul ba'i gdung dbyangs thugs rje'i rol mo bzhugs/ e ma ho/ gling mchog dag pa dpal ri'i zhing na// rig 'dzin gtso mchog pad+ma 'byung gnas// ḍāk+ki'i gtso mo bde chen mtsho rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /gang des rjes bzung rig gsum sems dpa'i// sgyu ma'i 'phrul chen gsang 'dzin dpa' bo// dpal seng dngos snang mthu stobs gling pa/ khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs shig /bdag sogs 'di nas tshe rabs kun tu// dpal mgon bla ma khyed dang 'bral med// dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi zhing der// mngon sum khrid mdzod drin chen bla ma// byin rlabs smon lam gdams bzang stsol mdzod// ces pa 'di'ang sras mo byang chub sgron mas lha reg dang bcas bskul ngor tshul rgyas sug bris su bgyis pa 'dis kyang byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig ༈ gzhi rgyud lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du// sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du smin mdzad pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon kun bzang che ba'i lha// mthu stobs gling pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rtog tshogs lha skur 'char bar byin rlobs// rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa thig rlung gi khams// gnyug ma bde chen ye shes ston pa po// rdo rje rgyal po bde chen he ru ka khrag 'thung bde chen rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// bde stong rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs// 'od gsal rin chen snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// chos nyid rig pa rtsal gyi dbang bskur zhing*// kun bzang dgongs pa chos sku ngo sprod pa'i// rig 'dzin klong yangs rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// phung po 'od skur grol bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang sngags btsun las 'brel rtsal gyis rje de nyid kyi mdun nas gsang sngags rgyud 'bum lung nod skabs dgos pa nan cher mthong nas bris pa phyis gsol 'debs su tshig phrad bsgyur ba 'di rje nyid kyi gsung par nges/

de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig ༈ gdod ma'i gzhi la mngon par byang chub cing*// bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gsal mdzad pa// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// don brgyud dgongs pa rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// rig rtsal longs sku'i zhing khams tshad la phebs// chos zad gdod ma'i grub mtha' snyog pa dang*// kun bzang chos sku'i ngo bor ro gcig shog /bdag gi mos dge phun sum tshogs pa dang*// rtsa gsum lha dang srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis// dpal mgon bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing*// phrin las 'gong med phyogs brgyar 'phel gyur cig / gang mos kyi chog go kun dga'i ngor pad+ma las 'brel gyis so// 'di khrom sprul a rig zhabs brtan yin/ ༈ oṃ swa sti si taṃ/ skyabs 'os dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum// rtsa gsum lha dang rdo rje'i yal gam can// phyi nang gsang ba'i bstan srung ma lus pa// kun nas brtse bas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gi mos dge phun sum tshogs pa 'dis// bstan dang 'gro ba rtsa lag rin po che// snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i gnyen// mtshungs med bla ma dam pa zhabs brtan gsol// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// tshul gnas thos bsam bsgom pas rab zhugs nas// nyes pa'i dri ma bag tsam mi dmigs pa// gnas brtan chos kyi glang po zhabs brtan gsol// rgyal ba'i chos khams ma lus 'dzin pa'i gzhi// rin chen byang chub sems la thugs 'byor zhing*// phyin drug spyod pa'i sgo nas byan tshud pa// gzhan phan chos kyi nyi ma zhabs brtan gsol// tha snyad shes bya'i de nyid mjal ba la// kun khyab tshad ma gsum gyis rab gzhal bas// ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i gter chen rdol// 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros zhabs brtan gsol// tha mal snang dang zhen pa'i rtog pa kun// yongs grub rdo rje gsum du rgyas btab cing*// lhag pa'i lha dang gnyis su ma mchis pa// dpal chen che mchog 'dus pa zhabs brtan gsol// kun rtog g.yo ba rtsa rlung thig le'i chos// 'pho med dbu ma'i dbyings su rab sdom pas// lhan skyes bde chen rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa// 'chi med grub pa'i dbang po zhabs brtan gsol// brgyud gsum bla ma'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i chus// sems nyid rin chen gsang ba'i rgyal thabs la// cog bzhag bka' rtags bzhi yis dbang bsgyur ba/

khyab bdag nam mkha'i 'khor lo zhabs brtan gsol// rgyal bstan dri med rin chen snang ba la// bshad sgrub 'khor lo gnyis kyis legs bzung ba'i// phrin las nub med nyi zla'i rjes 'gro ba// nam yang nub med rtag tu 'char gyur cig / ces sgrub brtson rtogs ldan sau li bla ma ye shes rdo rjes bskul ngor gsol 'debs dang zhabs brtan 'thus phyogs 'thus par chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos chu phag zla 2 tshes 23 gyi tho rangs la smras pa rten 'byung dge bar yod do// wam̐ ) ༈ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ gdod nas rnam dag kun bzang chos kyi sku// yan lag bdun ldan bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// nges pa lnga ldan 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// ye shes sgyu ma'i mgon khyed zhabs brtan gsol// kun brtags ma dag 'khrul pa'i snang ba kun// yongs grub dkyil 'khor gsum du rnam dag pas// gdan gsum lha yi rang bzhin mngon gyur pa// rdo rje slob dpon mchog khyed zhabs brtan gsol// kun rtog las rlung g.yo ba'i bag chags rnams// 'pho med dbu ma'i dbyings su thim pa las// bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes sa bcu'i mthar// mi slob bzung 'jug ngo bor zhabs brtan gsol// ma rig gzung 'dzin sems kyi 'ching ba kun// gnad gsum ye shes 'khor lo rab sbyangs bas// 'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang mchog rtag brtan 'gyur ba med parazhabs brtan gsol// bdag gi mos dge phun sum tshogs pa dang*// rtsa gsum lha dang dam can bden mthu yis// ji ltar smon pa'i don rnams ma lus kun// gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang mchog sprul kun bzang tshul khrims kyi yang le mchog sprul zhabs brtan rgyud lung man ngag dang 'brel ba 'di rje nyid kyi dngos slob pad byams ngor mkhan ming tshul khrims rgya mtshos spel ba dge'o// ༈ oṃ swa ra swa sti ye// spyan ras gzigs dbang dge ba'i bshes snang ba// gang gis thog med bskal pa'i dus ring nas// mkha' khyab 'gro ba 'dren par dam bcas pa// thugs rje chen po gzigs pa mi 'dor na// zhi ba'i dbyings su gzims pa ji ltar 'os// 'di na mos pas gdung ba'i mig gnyis po// mchi mas rab tu brlan pa'i gsol 'debs ngag

/gsan nas bsam bzhin sprul pa gzugs kyi skur// cir yang 'char ba'i rnam rol mtha' yas pa// ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i sku mchog bstan du gsol// mgon khyod rtag tu gzhan phan dgongs pa la// yang dang yang du bskul lta mi 'tshal te// bdag blo gdung ba'i shugs kyis mi bzod par// gsol btab 'bras bu myur du smin par mdzod// mkhas btsun grub pa'i rnam thar bsam yas kyi// phun tshogs dpal des yongs bzung sgra snyan rnga// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas nam yang sgrogs par mdzod// legs bshad 'khor lo gsum gyi bkra shis kyis// mngon rtogs rin chen nor bu'i ba gam brgya// thub bstan ris med zhing 'dir mdzes byas te// sna tshogs gdul bya'i re ba skong bar mdzod// bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i rab dkar gos// mchog gsum rgyal ba'i bden tshig bslu med mthus// thub pa'i legs gsung bstan pa 'di gnas bar// mi nub rtag pa nam yang 'char gyur cig / ces pa'ang rta dang mda' tshab rin sgang pa'i ngor 7kaḥthog mkhan ming pas phul ba dge legs su gyur cig ༈ thub bstan mdo sngags bshad sgrub chos kyi tshul// kun mkhyen smra ba'i nyi ma phyogs kyi glang*// mgon khyod spros pa nyer zhi chos kyi dbyings// kun bzang chos sku'i rgyal thabs la dgyes mdzod// bu slob rjes 'jug snyigs ma'i sems can rnams// thugs rje'i ye shes gzigs pas mi 'dor bar// lhun grub phyi gsal rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// bstan dang 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal mgon du// rgyal ba'i myu gu myur du 'char bar mdzod// 'jam dpal rdo rje rnon pos rjes bzung zhing*// grub gnyis yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i dbang phyug mchog /ji lta ji snyed gzigs pa'i blo gros gter// bka' drin mtshungs med dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal// snga 'gyur bstan pa gsal ba'i gnyen gcig pu// mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar dri med kyis// sprul pa 'gro la phan slad rtag bzhengs gsol// dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi bden pa dang*// rtsa gsum lha dang dam can byin rlabs mthus// bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam dag mthus// ji ltar smon pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig

sngags btsun pad+ma las 'brel gyis thugs dam gnad bskul dang 'brel nas gsol ba btab pas de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ e ma ho// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rje// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi bdag /mgon khyod gdod nas mngon par byang chub mod// gdul bya'i mos ngor gang 'dul cir yang 'char// chos dbyings chos sku nang gsal phra ba'i sbubs// zhi ba phyogs gcig dbyings su mi bzhugs par// mkha' khyab rdul snyed zhing du de snyed kyi// phyi gsal sprul pa sku gsum ye shes kyi// rnam rol cir yang 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// bka' drin mtshungs med rig 'dzin pad+ma gling*// thugs rjes gzigs pas bdag sogs bu slob la// slob pa lam gyi dam bca' rjes dgongs shing*// sprul pa'i rnam rol myur du snang bar mdzod// bdag gi mos dge rnam par dag pa dang*// rtsa gsum lha dang dam can srung ma'i mthus// 'di ltar smon pa'i don rnams ma lus kun// gegs med myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang 7skyabs rje bla ma pad+ma gling pa rnga yab gling du gshegs pa'i tshe rje de nyid kyis slob 'bangs su gyur pa kaḥthog mkhan ming pas gsol ba btab pa dge legs su gyur cig ༈ kyai/ rig 'dzin gdung 'tshob dpal mgon bla ma rje// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i dpal// mgon khyed zhi ba phyogs gcig mi bzhed par// slob pa lam gyi dam bca' mthar phyin dgongs// chos sku skye med spros pa'i mtha' bral yang*// lnga ldan sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po las// 'gags med sprul pa'i rnam rol bsam yas pas// bdag cag gdul bya'i re ba skong bar mdzod// dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi byin mthu yis// ji ltar smon pa'i don rnams 'di dag kun// gegs med yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang khro zur rdo rje bdud 'joms rin po che dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs skabs/

slar yang yang srid myur 'byon gyi smon pa 'di sku gdung rin po che'i mdun nas kaḥthog mkhan ming pas phul ba'o// ༈ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ thugs rje chen po'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar// bdag cag gdul bya'i mos ngor 'char ba'i dpyid// 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i ngo bo ru// bskal pa ji srid bar du zhabs brtan gsol// rnam dag tshul khrims yon tan rgya mtsho'i bdag /mang thos lung rtogs chos ldan mnga' dbang bsgyur// don gnyis lhun grub bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon du// nam yang 'gong med 'char ba'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang rje dbon rin po che'i mdun khri 'bul dang 'brel bar tshul khrims rgya mtshos so// oṃ swā stī sid+dhi/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma rje// 'gro khams rgya mtsho smin cing grol ba'i phyir// bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag phan bde'i gnyen gcig pu// pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho zhabs brtan gsol// gu ru'i thugs sras rdo rje bdud 'joms rtsal// sprul pa'i rol gar cir yang 'char ba yi// 'brel tshad don ldan mchog gi sprul pa'i sku// bskal pa ji srid bar du 'tsho gzhes gsaul// skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rin po che// bdag gi mos dge phun sum tshogs pa'i mthus// ji ltar smon pa'i don kun gegs med du// yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa'ang o rgyan gsang sngags gling pa'i bstan pa spyi'i lung bstan las/ sngags pa rdo rje bdud 'joms ni// mtsho bu badz+ra bdud 'dul 'byung*// zhes lung gis bsngags pa sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms dang rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru sogs kyi sprul pa'i rol gar mtsho bu grub chen rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi yang srid mchog la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa byin cing mtshan gyi mnga' 'bul dang chab cig zhabs brtan phul ba po kaḥthog mkhan ming tshul khrims rgya mtshos spel/

༈ oṃ swa sti/ gdod nas srid zhi kun khyab rdo rje sems// lha sras dam 'dzin ye shes rol pa rtsal// grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma nor bu'i mtshan// bka' drin mnyam med mgon khyod zhabs brtan gsol// rgyal ba'i ring lugs gsang chen snga 'gyur ba'i// mdo sngags bshad sgrub rgya mtsho'i 'khor los bsgyur// 'phags nor yan lag bdun gyis dpung tshogs bcas// mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la zhabs brtan gsol// 'pho med rtag brtan 'chi med tshe mtha' yas// mi shigs gzhom zhig bral ba ye sangs rgyas// kun bzang chos sku'i ngo bor 'tsho zhes gsol// bdag gi mos dge phun sum tshogs pa dang*// rtsa gsum bstan dang dkon mchog bden pa'i mthus// ji ltar smon pa yid bzhin 'grub pa yi// bkra shis dpal gyis sa gsum snang bar shog /

ces pa'ang snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan grub dbang chos kyi glang po'i yang srid zhabs brtan du dpal yul mchog sprul rin po che'i bka' bskul gnang bar brten/ mkhan ming tshul khrims rgya mtshos gus pas phul ba de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig ༈ bde gshegs dam pa chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur// spobs pa mtha' yas bla ma kaḥthog pa// deng sang 'di na bstan 'gro'i dpal du ngoms// mi pham bshad sgrub chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes// gang mtshan snyan pas srid gsum zlum por bcings// sa gsum skye dgu'i gtsug na g.yo med pa// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i 'dren pa zla maid pa'i// zhabs kyi pad+mo brten pa'i khri drung du// gus zhus// bod chen po'i ljongs kyi sa yi thig ler brten pa rang byung pad+ma rgyal pos byin gyis brlabs pas gzi byin ngo mtshar gyi ya mtshan cir yang snying la sbyin pa'i gtsug lag khang tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas dpal kaḥthog gdan rabs rim byon gser ri'i phreng ba lta bu las mngon par 'phags pa/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i shes rab kyi cha shas ma gang ba med pa/ 'chad pa dang rtsod pa dang rtsom pa'i gnas gang la'ang*/ rang lugs kyi khas len gzhan lugs kyi skyon dpyod la brgal brtag gis nyam nga ba med pa'i spobs pa dge ba can gang gis snga 'gyur ba'i mdo sgyu sems gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyal bstan rma med pa snying por mdzad nas sgrub rgyud kyi srog rtsa sbom por btod nas mdzad pa'i rlabs chen skyong ba la kho bo rgyu mtshan dang bcas te mngon par bstod do// rjes su yi rang ngo*// gang gi thugs bskyed dkar ba 'gro skyo dbus// bshad sgrub nyi ma'i snang ba rab drangs nas// bstan 'gro'i dge mtshan gsar du 'bod pa la// blo yi pad+mo mi 'bod yongs ma mchis// slad ma/ kun btags ma dag 'khrul pa'i chos so cog /dag pa gzhan dbang 'khor los rgyas btab nas// yongs grub mnyam pa chen po'i ngo bo ru// kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin khyod zhabs brtan gsol// mi rtag g.yo ba dkar dmar rlung sems khams// 'gyur med dbu ma'i dbyings su rab btsang bas// 'chi med gnyug ma dam pa'i ngo bo ru// zung 'jug bde chen rdo rjer zhabs brtan gsol// rtog pa'i rang gzugs ma dag 'byung ba'i khams// rtsol med theg mchog rgyal po'i gsang lam nas// snang dang stong pa'i chos zad ye yin klong*// 'pho med 'ja' lus rdo rjer zhabs brtan gsol//

༈ oṃ swa sti/ rgyal kun mthu stobs ngo bo gsang ba'i bdag /gu ru'i thugs sras shud bu dpal gyi seng*// grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' chos kyi dbang*// zhing 'dir bdag cag mos ngor sprul pa'i sku// rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang skal bzang bstan pa'i 'dzin// gzhi dbyings khyad chos drug ldan chos kyi sku// kun bzang gdod ma'i dbyings su gzim gyur kyang*// rjes 'jug gdung bas thugs rje'i rgyud bskul na// bstan dang 'gro ba 'dun la phan slad du// mkhyen brtse'i rgyal ba'i myu gur myur snang bas// mkhas btsun grub pa'i rnam thar bsam yas kyis// rgyal bstan mdo sngags bshad dang sgrub pa'i sdes// 'dzin ma'i khyon kun rab tu mdzes byas te// snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i rgud pa kun bsal nas// bkra shis snang bas sa gsum khyab par mdzod// ces rig pa 'dzin pa mchog sprul skal bzang bstan 'dzin dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa slar yang sprul pa'i zla zhal myur du 'byon par dmigs nas pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge legs su gyur cig ༈ oṃ swa sti sid+dhi/ rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i gter chena'ajam pa'i dbyangs// gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me khri lde rje// zab gter spyi mes nyi ma 'od zer ni// bka' drin mtshungs med skyabs rje bla ma nyid// khyed thugs rdo rje dbyings kyi rgyal khab nas// thugs rje ye shes sgyu ma'i rol pa las// bdag cag mos ngor gzugs sku'i snang ba yi// bslab gsum yon tan rin chen 'bum brdal zhing*// bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma gsal byas nas// snyigs ma'i rgud pa ma lus gtan zhi nas// sprul pa'i gzugs sku myur du snang bar mdzod// ces pa'ang sku gdung rin po che'i mdun nas gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge ༈ e ma ho/ 'di nas nyi ma lho nub mtshams shed na// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas// ri klung yul ljongs rin chen zangs las grub// bar snang 'od dmar snang bas khengs pa snyam// ri yi rtsa ba sri po'i phreng bas bskor// rked pa brag ri mtshon cha'i dbyibs 'dra gzengs// rtse mo mkha' 'gro'i yul ljongs dpal gyi ri// rin chen las grub gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs// de dbus rin chen pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*// rig 'dzin gtso bo rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// mtshan dpe yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma rje// gzi brjid 'od 'bar 'od zer drug phrag 'phro// gsang sngags zab mo'i gsung dbyangs 'u ru ru// 'od gsal dgongs pa bar mtshams med par bzhugs// rig 'dzin bla ma'i drung der skye bar shog

/g.yas g.yon gral na rgya bod rig 'dzin dang*// ma sring mkha' 'gro'i gar stabs lang ling bsgyur// brtul zhugs spyod pas tha ma snang ba 'gags// ya mtshan chen po'i zhing der skye bar shog /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams snang ba de de nyid// lhun grub 'od lnga'i snang ba me re re// rang snang rgyan rdzogs yon tan du mas rgyan// lnga ldan chen po'i zhing der skye bar shog snang ba dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sprin gtib cing*// grags pa gsang chen brda skad lhangs se lhang*// dran rtog ye shes chen po'i rol pa las// mi g.yo dag pa'i zhing der skye bar shog brgyud gsum rig 'dzin byin rlabs sprin gtib cing*// yi dam lha yi dngos grub char 'beb pa// mkha' 'gro dam can phrin las glog 'khyug cing*// dbugs chen 'byin pa'i zhing der skye bar shog /bdag sogs nam zhig 'du byed gtong ba na// rig 'dzin bla ma'i snang ba mi 'bral zhing*// yi dam lha yi bkra shis me tog gtib// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis dag pa'i mdun bsu zhing*// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog /de nas mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog o rgyan rje'i// brtse bas rjes gzung gsang chen smin grol myong*// mchog thun dngos grub gsar ba'i lang tsho 'bar// pad+ma'i phrin las bdag por 'gyur bar shog / ༈ na mo mañdzu shri ye/ rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'jam dpal dbyangs// rnam pa rgyal sras thu bo mchog tu snang*// zhing 'di'i rgyal dang rgyal sras ma lus pa// mgon po nyid kyi dang por thugs bskyed pa// bar du rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho la// sbyar nas rdzogs smin sbyang pa mthar son pas// tha ma zab rgyas chos kyi mdzod 'dzin cing*// rgyal sras kun gyi bsngags la gsol ba 'debs// gangs ljongs bstan pa snang ba'i sgo 'phar 'byed// mdo sngags lam gyi chos tshul ma lus pa// rigs can gdul bya'i tshogs la legs 'dom pa// khri lde btsan po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gang gi sgyu 'phrul ye shes rol pa ni// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang por mngon par snang*// ka chen bcu dang shing rta rnam pa brgyad// ljongs 'dir khyab par brdal la gsol ba 'debs// snyigs ma'i dus kyi gdul bya'i 'gro ba kun// yang dag lam gyis dmigs bu gsal byas te// bshad sgrub bstan pa spel la gsol ba 'debs// chos kyi blo gros 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo'i tshul// gzungs dang spobs pa blo gros mi zad pa// bka' drin mtshungs med khyed la gsol ba 'debs// skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi man ngag gis// srid pa 'khor mtha' nyid la blo ldog cing*// bar du zhi ba phyogs gcig las grol zhing*// byang chub sems dpa'i sa bon legs btab pas// bdag blo chos la phyogs pa khyed kyi drin// smin byed dbang bzhi'i rgyal thabs la bkod nas// bcos ma bskyed pa'i rim pa'i man ngag gis// snang srid ro mnyam lha sngags ye shes rdzogs// gzugs sku'i nye rgyu'i sbyin la gsol ba 'debs// lhan skyes ye shes mchog la rab byor zhing*// 'khor 'das dbyer med lta ba ngo sprod c-ing*// chos sku'i dgongs pa sbyin la gsol ba 'debs// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs kyis// mgon po khyod kyi bka' drin gso ba dang*// ma gyur sems can kun la phan slad du// mgon po khyed kyi go 'phang thob par shog

/de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs kun tu yang*// thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab rgyud sbyang nas// rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed par shog / ces pa 'di ni rdo rje'i mched dam pa shes rab 'od zer gyis nan tan chen pos bskul ngor sngags btsun las kyi rdo rjes shar mar spel ba dge'o// ༈ rgyal kun dbang phyug o rgyan pad+ma 'byung*// mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// bka' drin mnyam med gu ru rin po che// gsol ba 'debs so 'di phyir thugs rjes zungs// pad+ma las 'brel gyis so// ༈ sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos gsol ba 'debs// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes pa'ang bla ma rdo rje'i ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris ba dge'o// ༈ mtsho skyes rdo rje o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// chos mthun bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog / mi dgos dgu dgos bla ma nor li'i ngor// chos med skyid gal pad+ma las 'brel gyis// sems kyi rnam rtog ri mo'i lam du bris// dge bas rnam rtog spros pa chod par shog /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i gter gcig pu// mtshan dpe'i lang tsho'i ngo mtshar ma// 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes mtshan chags pa// khyod ni sangs rgyas nyid du dran// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bye snyed bskal pa grangs med dus// bde gshegs klu rigs sgron mar grags// mngon par byang chub go 'phang brnyes// yang dag lam du 'gro ba 'dren// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis// sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam gyur kyang*// thugs bskyed phrin las rlabs po che// mi mnyam khyad par kun las 'phags// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod la rtogs pa'i gzo med kyang*// snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gis// sgyu ma ji ltar snang ba bzhin// rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rgyun mi chad// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab// zhing rnams dag ni mtha' yas na// tshangs dang dbang phyug mig stong ldan// sems can don la rab tu brtson// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mi dang lha min dbang po dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems// mu stegs gzugs dang cha lugs kyis// gdam ngag rjes su ston mdzad pa// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// res 'ga' zhi chags gtum par snang*// nyon mongs gzhan dbang ma gyur pas// gser mdog bzang mo'i rgyud btul bzhin// nyon mongs dgra rgyal rnam par rgyal// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// res 'ga' bgegs rgyal sdig par sprul// srid pa gsum po'ajigs byed cing*// g.yo can bdud kyi ces 'di yang thos bsam la dga' ba/ brtson 'grus chung ba/ le lo che ba/ 'don tha nye bas thos bsam ma byas par lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlabs nas/ gnag rdzi rgan po ji bzhin 'dod pa sprang phrug bsod nams dpal ldan gyis bskul ngor/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang dpal bzang pos bris pas tshe rabs kyi skye ba thams cad du rje btsun gyis byin gyis rlob pa'i rgyur gyur cig maṅga lam/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun tu bzang po longs sku rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje dang*// 'jam dpal bshes gnyen rig 'dzin shrī seng*// dz+nyā na su tra paṇa chen bī ma la// pad+ma thod phreng chos rgyal khri lde'u btsan// ye shes mtsho rgyal lo chen bai ro'i zhabs// ting 'dzin bzang po gnas brtan ldang ma ba// seng ge dbang phyug rgyal ba zhang ston pa// mkhas pa nyi 'bum gu ru jo 'ber dang*// seng ge rgyab pa zla ba mun sel dang*// ku ma rā dza kun mkhyen klong chen pa// 'jigs med gling pa rgyal ba'i myu gu dang*// chos kyi dbang po bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs// pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// mi phyed snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa na// thugs dam dgongs pa g.yel ba med pa dang*// thugs rjes 'jug pas rjes su bzung nas su// don brgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlab stsal du gsol// rmog sprul kun bzang rgya mtsho'i ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis so/// /
